name: SearchBug
instructions: Open https://www.searchbug.com/privacy-requests.aspx and follow the site's steps for {full_name}. Use {contact_email} wherever it asks for an email address, so the reply is matched. Then press "I've done this".
notes: SearchBug says an opt-out needs the name and enough detail to find the record.
source: Opt-out page listed in The Opt-Out Manual 2026 (thumpersecure/opt-out-manual-2026, public domain). On 2026-10-11 the manual's page turned out to be a general contact form; the privacy page found instead links to a separate form that couldn't be checked, so this plugin ships turned off.
